Ходьбу учат с наградой только за скорост: Walking is trained with a reward only for the torso's forward speed, and falling isn't penalized at all. What will the policy learn?
Ляжет на пол и будет отталкиваться ногам: It will lie down on the floor and push off with its legs: that's also moving forward, and there's no need to keep balance
Научится идти, потому что ходьба и есть: It will learn to walk, because walking is moving forward
Будет идти медленно и осторожно, чтобы н: It will walk slowly and carefully so as not to fall
Награда задаёт, чего добиться, а не как,: A reward sets what to achieve, not how, and the policy achieves exactly what is written. In Lab 1, Ada with only the speed reward fell after 0.6 s and crawled on her torso at 1.37 m/s until the end of the run, more than twice as fast as the full-reward Ada. A fall penalty doesn't close this loophole but changes it: Ada speeds up in a crouch and falls after a second. Only the full reward of nine terms gave walking without loopholes.
Конструктор награды: от «только вперёд»: Reward builder: from “forward only” to nine terms
Политику ходьбы учили с полной наградой,: A walking policy was trained with the full reward, but in training it always got the same velocity command. What happens if you give it a noticeably faster command?
Она пойдёт медленнее команды: связывать: It will walk slower than the command: nobody taught it to link the number in its input to the speed
Она выйдет на новую скорость: команда вх: It will reach the new speed: the command is part of the observation, and there is a reward for following the command
Она пойдёт быстрее команды: число во вхо: It will walk faster than the command: the number in its input is larger than usual, and the policy will overdo it
Если команда на обучении одна и та же, в: If the command is the same throughout training, it's a constant in the policy's input, and nothing in training checks what to do with a different number. In Lab 2, with a 0.9 m/s command, the random-command Ada walked at 0.88 m/s, while the Ada that had only seen 0.6 m/s walked at 0.71 m/s: the constant number in her input worked as a bias. That's why Rudin et al. give each copy its own command for the whole episode, and Radosavovic et al. a new one every 10 seconds.
Копии робота в симуляторе почти ничего н: Robot copies in a simulator cost almost nothing, and one GPU fits several times more of them than Rudin et al. use. Why don't they take more copies for the same rollout batch?
У каждой копии осталось бы слишком мало: Each copy would have too few consecutive steps, and GAE needs the rewards of several consecutive steps
Каждая лишняя копия замедляет симуляцию,: Each extra copy slows down the simulation, and training would take longer
Слишком разные копии мешают политике выу: Copies that are too different keep the policy from learning a single gait
Порция опыта на обновление равна числу к: The rollout batch per update equals the number of copies times the steps of each. The authors tried from 128 to 16,384 robots: when each has fewer than 25 consecutive steps, that is less than 0.5 s, quality drops sharply, and when there are few robots, it declines slowly, because neighboring steps of one robot are similar to each other. Meanwhile, training time falls almost linearly up to 4,000 robots, and the authors name 2,048 to 4,096 robots with a batch of about 100,000 steps as the best compromise.
Политика Digit у Radosavovic и соавторов: The Digit policy of Radosavovic et al. takes the latest “observation, action” pairs as input. Why does it need this history?
По тому, как тело ответило на прошлые де: How the body responded to past actions shows what the floor underfoot is like and whether there was a push, and the policy adapts without changing its weights
По истории политика сама решает, куда ид: From the history, the policy decides on its own where to go, and it doesn't need a velocity command
История нужна только на обучении: по ней: The history is needed only in training: the teacher uses it to check the student
Авторы называют это адаптацией в контекс: The authors call this in-context adaptation, by analogy with language models: the network's weights don't change, the history does. The policy is a causal transformer over the 16 latest pairs, and the causal mask lets each token look only at past ones. In ablations, the transformer beat MLP, TCN and LSTM by a clear margin, and a long context beat a short one; the policy transferred to the robot without fine-tuning and walked the streets for a week without a single fall.
Digit: трансформер по истории и перенос: Digit: a transformer over history and transfer without fine-tuning
Чем AMP заменяет награду за близость поз: What does AMP use instead of the reward for the pose's closeness to the recording frame?
Наградой стиля от дискриминатора, которы: A style reward from a discriminator that learns to tell transitions between the policy's consecutive states from transitions in the recordings
Сравнением с ближайшим по времени кадром: A comparison with the recording frame closest in time instead of the frame at the same phase
Сравнением со средним по всем кадрам зап: A comparison with the average over all frames of the recording, so as not to choose which frame to compare with
Дискриминатор смотрит на переходы, потом: The discriminator looks at transitions because the recording has no actions, and the policy gets more the less its transitions differ from the recorded ones. There's no phase and no choice of recording, so dozens of unlabeled recordings go into training, and the gait changes with the command. The price is accuracy: on a single walking recording, AMP's pose error is 0.030 m against 0.018 m for tracking, and in Lab 2, the AMP policy has 10.4° against 5.4° for the tracker.
AMP: дискриминатор вместо награды за кад: AMP: a discriminator instead of a per-frame reward
Трекер с фазой, как в DeepMimic, обучен: A phase-based tracker, as in DeepMimic, is trained on one walking recording. It gets a command to walk faster than the person in the recording walked. What will happen?
Он пойдёт медленнее команды: фаза растёт: It will walk slower than the command: the phase advances at the recording's rate, and the reward for the frame at that phase pulls it toward the recording's speed
Он ускорит шаг: награда за скорость по к: It will speed up its steps: a reward for the commanded speed is part of its reward
Он остановится: запись и команда противо: It will stop: the recording and the command contradict each other
Фазовая переменная говорит политике, с к: The phase variable tells the policy which frame of the recording to compare the pose with, but, as the DeepMimic authors write, it limits the ability to change the tempo of the motion: to walk faster, you need a different recording. In Lab 2, with a 1.04 m/s command, the tracker walked at 0.92 m/s at the recording's step frequency, while the AMP policy, which has no phase, raised its step frequency to 1.12 Hz and walked at 1.03 m/s.

Да: если суставы в пределах и стопы на п: Yes: if the joints are within limits and the feet are on the floor, the recording is feasible
Да, если запись медленная: тогда равнове: Yes, if the recording is slow: then balance takes care of itself

That's why H2O runs the transferred recordings through a tracker in simulation and throws out the ones it can't reproduce.

В библиотеке CMU нет записей движений но: The CMU library has no recordings of leg motion
Главная идея авторов ExBody — «не повтор: The key idea of the ExBody authors is “to NOT mimic exactly the same as the reference motion.” In their experiments, whole-body tracking gave the worst results on all metrics, and without starting from the recording, training didn't work at all. AMP as an addition to the reward made episodes longer, but the robot held the velocity command worse and walked on almost straight legs, and the authors write that the AMP reward alone isn't enough for such a system.
На настоящих гуманоидах: верх по записи,: On real humanoids: upper body from the recording, legs from the command
Генералист с маской команд и специалист,: A generalist with a command mask and a specialist trained by the same teacher in only one mode reproduce a new recording. What will the comparison show?
В своём режиме точнее специалист, но в ч: In its own mode the specialist is more accurate, but in another mode its error is several times the generalist's, and the generalist works in all modes and switches them on the move
Генералист точнее во всех режимах: общее: The generalist is more accurate in all modes: shared knowledge of all modes helps in each one
Разницы нет: учитель у них один, и учатс: No difference: they have the same teacher and learn from the same recordings
Специалисту не нужно делить сеть между 3: The specialist doesn't have to share its network among 31 combinations of command parts. In Lab 2, on a new squat with outstretched arms, its error was 1.62 cm against 2.83 cm for the generalist, while in another mode the “hands and feet” specialist erred by 10.84 cm, and the generalist by 2.87 cm. In HOVER, the generalist outperformed the specialists, but there the specialists were trained with reinforcement learning and the generalist with distillation, and part of the gain may come from the training method itself.
Чем универсальный трекер H2O отличается: How does the universal H2O tracker differ from the DeepMimic recording tracker?
Он получает целевой кадр во входе как ча: It gets the target frame in its input as part of the command, so one policy reproduces any recording it is fed, including the pose of a person in front of a camera
Он точнее повторяет одну запись, потому: It reproduces a single recording more accurately because it learns on thousands of copies of it
Ему не нужна физическая симуляция: он уч: It doesn't need a physics simulation: it learns directly from the recordings
Трекеру с фазой известно, в каком месте: A phase-based tracker knows where in the recording it is, but not which recording it is, so a new motion needs a new policy. H2O feeds the policy the positions of body points from the next frame and so trains one policy on about 8,500 AMASS recordings. It throws out the recordings that even a teacher with privileged information can't reproduce: in Lab 1, the teacher failed on 5 recordings out of 10, and a check of the recording frames would have caught only two of them.
Одна политика на тысячи записей: целевой: One policy for thousands of recordings: the target frame in the input
Расставь по порядку, как из записей движ: Put in order how a whole-body tracker for a real robot is obtained from recordings of human motion.
Ретаргетинг: записи людей переносят на т: Retargeting: human recordings are transferred to the robot's body
Фильтр: учитель с привилегированной инфо: Filtering: a teacher with privileged information runs the recordings in physics, and the infeasible ones are thrown out
Дистилляция: умение учителя переносят в: Distillation: the teacher's skill is transferred to a student that has only the robot's sensors and a masked command
Поправка: по записям настоящего робота у: Correction: a delta model is trained on recordings of the real robot, and the student is fine-tuned in it
This is the common order that took shape across the works in the lesson. H2O added physics-based filtering of recordings to retargeting, OmniH2O and HOVER transfer the teacher's skill to the student with DAgger, and the command mask tells the student which body parts are set. ASAP closes the gap with the robot through a correction to the simulator learned from the robot's own recordings, and the policy is then transferred to the robot without the correction.
Трекер всего тела как нижний уровень гум: The whole-body tracker as the humanoid's low level
Политику перенесли на настоящую Аду, и о: The policy was transferred to the real Ada, and the error grew. Fitting mass and friction to the robot's recordings (SysID) slightly reduced the step prediction error but found mass and friction values different from the real ones. Why?
Расхождение было в задержке команды и сд: The mismatch was in the command delay and the ankle zero offset, which aren't on the parameter list, and SysID explained it with what is on the list
Записей было слишком мало, а с большим ч: There were too few recordings, and with more runs SysID would have found the right values
Масса и трение настоящей Ады меняются от: The real Ada's mass and friction change from run to run
Подбор параметров нашёл массу ×1,3 и тре: The parameter fit found mass ×1.3 and friction unchanged, while in fact the mass is ×1.15 and the friction ×1.5. The ASAP delta model isn't limited to a list: from Ada's recordings, it nearly canceled the new command and brought back the previous one, that is, it found the delay on its own, and its constant offset of 1.6° nearly matched the 1.7° ankle zero offset. After fine-tuning with the correction, the error on the real Ada dropped from 4.90 to 2.77 cm, and with the SysID parameters only to 3.65 cm.
Дельта-модель: научить симулятор вести с: Delta model: teaching the simulator to behave like Ada
Почему модели зрения и языка, которая от: Why isn't a vision-language model, which responds a few times a second, given direct control of a humanoid's legs?
Корпус на ногах неустойчив: отклонение п: A torso on legs is unstable: after a push, the deviation grows faster than a new response arrives, so balance is kept by the whole-body controller, which sees the body much more often
Такая модель не умеет выдавать углы суст: Such a model can't output joint angles, only words
Ноги гуманоида умеют вести только класси: Only classical controllers written by people can drive a humanoid's legs
Без перестановки опоры отклонение корпус: Without moving the support, the torso's deviation grows exponentially. In Lab 1, the Ada that got a ready-made whole-body plan from a 5 Hz model didn't deliver the cup in any of 20 runs and only managed at 50 Hz, while the Ada with the body controller placed the cup in 19–20 runs out of 20 at any model frequency. For the upper-level model, it's enough to decide where and how fast to walk: these decisions change slowly.
По спокойным записям оператора учат поли: A policy that places the feet itself, without a body controller, is trained on calm operator recordings. What will twice as many such recordings give?
Почти ничего: в спокойных записях нет от: Almost nothing: calm recordings have no deviations and no record of how they were corrected, and the policy's small errors accumulate just the same
Политика станет надёжной: ей просто не х: The policy will become reliable: it simply lacked recordings
Политика научится ловить толчки: в запис: The policy will learn to catch pushes: the recordings will have more steps
По 20 записям политика по шагам поставил: With 20 recordings, the step-level policy placed the cup in 6 runs out of 20, and with 40 in 5, while the policy that sets the velocity for the body controller needed only 10 recordings to place the cup in 20 runs out of 20. A torso on legs also amplifies small errors, as in lesson 1.1. Recordings with pushes help, like DAgger in lesson 1.2, but in them Ada was caught by the body controller, and the policy learns a copy of it, so recordings are used to teach only what the controller can't know: where to go and what to do with the hands.
Что учить по записям: цели для ног или к: What to learn from recordings: targets for the legs or commands for the controller
Модель VLA над трекером SONIC учили выда: A VLA model on top of the SONIC tracker was trained to output either explicit poses of all joints or motion tokens that the tracker can execute. What happened to task success?
С токенами успех был намного выше: мален: With tokens, success was much higher: a small error in a whole-body pose turns into a large tracking error, and compact tokens are easier to learn
С явными позами успех выше: модель задаё: With explicit poses, success is higher: the model sets every motion itself and controls the legs more precisely
Успех одинаковый: трекер исполняет любую: Success is the same: the tracker executes any command equally well
На трёх задачах успех с токенами был в с: Across three tasks, success with tokens averaged 68%, and with explicit poses 27%; on the can task, it was 60% against zero. At the same time, TWIST2 kept explicit angles of all joints in the command and taught the robot to push a box with its foot. There's no single answer yet: the more of the body the model sets itself, the more it can do and the more precise it has to be.
Что модель верхнего уровня задаёт ногам:: What the upper-level model specifies for the legs: velocity, joints or a learned vector
Расставь по порядку, как в TWIST2 записи: Put in order how teleoperation recordings become an autonomous policy in TWIST2.
Сбор: оператор в шлеме двигается, ретарг: Collection: the operator in a headset moves, retargeting turns the operator's pose into commands, and the tracker executes them on the robot
Запись: кадры камеры робота и команды тр: Recording: frames from the robot's camera and the commands to the tracker are saved in pairs
Обучение: Diffusion Policy учится по кар: Training: Diffusion Policy learns to output the same commands from the image
Работа: Diffusion Policy даёт команды то: Deployment: Diffusion Policy gives commands to the same tracker instead of the operator
Нижний уровень один: трекер, который 50: There's a single lower level: a tracker that gets a command 50 times a second and outputs target joint angles. During data collection, the upper level is the operator with retargeting, and in deployment it's Diffusion Policy, so the teleoperation recordings already contain ready-made actions for the future policy. HOMIE and the Atlas of Boston Dynamics and TRI are built the same way, and from 50 demonstrations TWIST2 pushed a T-shaped box to a mark with its foot and got it there in 6 attempts out of 7.
Телеоперация всем телом записывает коман: Whole-body teleoperation records the lower level's commands
Кисть Shadow выносит моторы в основание: The Shadow hand moves its motors into the base and pulls the fingers with tendons. What does this give, and what's the price?
Пальцы становятся лёгкими и сильными, но: The fingers become light and strong, but the motors move into the base behind the wrist, so the hand as a whole is heavy, and the tendons wear and need re-tensioning
Вся кисть становится лёгкой, и руке хват: The whole hand becomes light, and weak actuators are enough for the arm
Тросы передают силу без потерь, поэтому: Tendons transmit force without losses, so the hand is more precise than one with motors in the fingers
RUKA с моторами в предплечье держала 6,0: RUKA, with its motors in the forearm, held 6.0 kg against 4.0 for the LEAP Hand, which has the same motors in its fingers. But the Shadow hand with its base weighs 4.3 kg, and in the lesson's lab such hands required 8518 actuators in the arms and 10413 in the legs: Ada got heavier, up to 43.4 kg. Tendons wear and stretch, and the RUKA authors calibrate every hand they assemble.
Ловкая кисть: тросы или моторы в пальцах: The dexterous hand: tendons or motors in the fingers
Редуктор с большим передаточным числом д: A gearbox with a high gear ratio gives a joint more torque. Why do humanoids built for learning still put quasi-direct drives with a low gear ratio in their legs?
Инерция ротора на выходе растёт как квад: The rotor inertia at the output grows as the square of the gear ratio: the actuator hits harder on touchdown, yields worse to a push, and the force at the foot can no longer be estimated from the motor current
С малым передаточным числом сустав точне: With a low gear ratio, the joint holds the target angle more precisely
Квазипрямые приводы дешевле, а момента н: Quasi-direct drives are cheaper, and any torque is enough for the legs
На схеме урока один и тот же мотор с ред: In the lesson's diagram, the same motor with a 100:1 gearbox hits 3.7 times harder on touchdown than with 6:1. Through a small gearbox, the force at the foot can be estimated from the current with an error of about ±10%, as in MIT Cheetah 3, while through a large one friction and inertia eat up that connection, and a torque sensor is put at the actuator output. Mini Cheetah, Berkeley Humanoid and Unitree's legs are built the first way, while Optimus, as Berkeley Humanoid describes it, went another way: harmonic drives and linear actuators, some of them with force sensors.
Привод сустава: мотор, редуктор, звено и: The joint actuator: motor, gearbox, link and the price of the gear ratio
Ада с коробкой берёт на борт мощный вычи: Ada with the box takes a powerful computer on board for the VLA model, and then a bigger battery. What will come of it?
Вычислитель заметно сократит время работ: The computer will noticeably cut the run time, and the bigger battery will add less time than it adds capacity: its mass also has to be carried, and on the step the knees hold it
Время работы вырастет вместе с ёмкостью: The run time will grow along with the battery capacity, and the computer doesn't affect it
Батарея побольше выгодна всегда: чем она: A bigger battery always pays off: the bigger it is, the longer and more confidently Ada works
В лаборатории Thor вместо Orin NX срезал: In the lab, Thor instead of Orin NX cut the run time from 2.7 to 1.6 h: 130 W, as much as Ada spends on walking. A battery like the H1's brought back 3.2 h at the cost of 3.3 kg, while a 2.3 kWh battery like Figure 03's would weigh 17.7 kg, and no actuator in the set would be enough for the knee. A humanoid's budget has no free parameters: the battery pays for the computer, and the knees pay for the battery.
Зачем в тактильном пальце Digit 360 нейр: Why does the Digit 360 tactile finger have a neural network accelerator?
Чтобы реагировать на касание на месте, н: To react to touch on the spot without waiting for the main computer, like a reflex arc: a fast loop next to the sensor, a slow one higher up
Чтобы сжимать картинку геля перед отправ: To compress the gel image before sending it to the cloud
Чтобы палец сам решал задачу без модели: So that the finger solves the task by itself without the upper-level model
Авторы сравнивают ускоритель с рефлектор: The authors compare the accelerator to a reflex arc: a touch event is processed in the finger, and the data doesn't travel to the main computer and back. It's the same rate ladder as in lesson 0.2, brought down to the fingertip. The finger itself gives about 8.3 million sensing points, and the force is predicted by a trained model from the gel image with a median error of about 1 mN.
Какой уровень системы управления у Figur: Which level of the control system of Figure 03, Digit and NEO is, according to published data, trained with reinforcement learning in simulation?
Контроллер всего тела, который держит ра: The whole-body controller that keeps balance: Helix's lower level at Figure, the motor cortex at Digit, the controller under Redwood at NEO
Модель верхнего уровня, которая понимает: The upper-level model that understands the scene and the request
Ни один: в симуляции их только проверяют: None: in simulation, they are only tested before release
Равновесие и шаги зависят от тела и физи: Balance and steps depend on the body and physics, which a simulator reproduces accurately enough. But packages, from rigid boxes to soft bags, are too varied to reproduce in a simulator, according to Figure, so the upper level is trained on teleoperation and human recordings. Boston Dynamics writes in 2026 that its whole-body controllers are also trained with reinforcement learning in simulation, while earlier Atlas kept its balance with MPC.
Управление: какие уровни обучены, а каки: Control: which levels are trained and which were written by people
Смена на заводе длится 8 часов, а батаре: A factory shift lasts 8 hours, and a humanoid's battery lasts 4 hours. Which robot will work the shift without a person's help?
Тот, кто сам меняет батарею или сам вста: One that swaps its own battery or docks itself to charge, like Atlas, Digit and Figure
Любой, если работать медленнее: тогда ба: Any robot, if it works more slowly: then the battery will last
Никакой: на одну смену гуманоиду всегда: None: for one shift, a humanoid always needs a second robot as a replacement
Ни одна из батарей, для которых опублико: None of the batteries with a published run time lasts an eight-hour shift, so a factory robot needs a way to keep working without a person. Atlas swaps its own battery, Digit docks itself to a charging station, and Figure 03 steps onto a stand and charges through coils in its feet. According to the lesson's table, only these three platforms work longer than one battery without a person, and all three already work at customer sites.
Тело: как платформы ответили на вопросы: Body: how the platforms answered the questions of lesson 6.5
Atlas учится трюкам по motion capture и: Atlas learns tricks from motion capture and human video, and Figure pretrains a model on human recordings from the Index app. What's the difference?
Движения людей учат нижний уровень двига: Human motion teaches the lower level to move, while recordings of how people work with their hands teach the model tasks
Разницы нет: обе компании учат задачам п: There's no difference: both companies teach tasks from human recordings
Atlas учится по записям людей задачам, а: Atlas learns tasks from human recordings, and Figure learns only walking from them
Atlas по motion capture и видео учит трю: Atlas learns lower-level tricks from motion capture and video, like the trackers of lesson 6.3, while Boston Dynamics taught it tasks through VR teleoperation. Figure hands out wearable cameras to people through the Index app and pretrained Helix 2.5 on those recordings, because teleoperation recordings grow no faster than operators work. Tesla, AgiBot and 1X also use human video to train the models that solve tasks.

Расставь по порядку, как Boston Dynamics: Put in order how Boston Dynamics changed the control system of Atlas.
Классический стек: паркур и танцы рассчи: Classical stack: parkour and dances are computed in advance, and on the go they are executed by an MPC planner and an optimization-based whole-body controller
LBM с TRI: обученная модель задаёт позы: LBM with TRI: a trained model sets the poses of the hands, torso and feet through the same MPC interface as teleoperation
Обученный нижний уровень: контроллер все: Trained lower level: a whole-body controller trained with reinforcement learning in simulation runs under the behavior models
Сначала обученной стала модель верхнего: First, in 2025, the upper level became a trained model, and then, in 2026, so did the whole-body controller. A stack written by people is understandable part by part and predictable, and on walking, MPC and the trained ZEST policy did almost equally well. On jogging and the cartwheel, the policy was more accurate, and it executed motions MPC doesn't support: a handstand, a roll on all fours and a dance.
Ада с ногами выходит на первую смену в д: Ada with legs starts her first shift in the house: six trials in a row, from the owner's commands to the Wi-Fi going down. Her system was put together from five decisions, one per lesson 6.1–6.5, and each looks reasonable but rests on a misconception that its lesson took apart. Start the shift, use the log to find which decision let her down in each failed trial, and replace it. When Ada passes all six trials, determine which platform of lesson 6.6 she resembles.
Каждое испытание проверяло главную мысль: Each trial tested the main idea of its lesson. A walking policy holds any velocity command only if the commands in training were random (6.1). A natural gait comes from recordings of human motion, and AMP also adapts the step to the speed, because it compares transitions rather than frames (6.2). A generalist with a command mask works in all modes and switches them on the move (6.3). A model that responds a few times a second sets the velocity, while balance is kept by the body controller, which sees the body 50 times a second (6.4). A model on board doesn't depend on the network, but the battery pays for a powerful computer, and the knees pay for a heavy battery (6.5). This Ada is built almost like NEO from 1X: her balance is kept by a controller trained in simulation, and at the upper level a small model runs on board (6.6).
